lines.en: I slide along the branch
One fold of my body and I turn
My head is blunt, it cannot split wood
I thread between the forks
The bark under me is slick
My whole body is moving
I cross from this limb to that
I bend the branch under me
I coil once around the trunk
I move faster than I look
My scales shine in the light
I travel under the leaves
I stretch my head out to check ahead
I fold back onto the same branch
I coil round the branch half a turn

lines.zh: 丛林里我窜得比叶子落得快
lines.en: In the jungle I dart faster than a falling leaf
I slip through the vines in silence.
My tail goes first, my head follows
I coil on the branch without moving
My head rests on my own coils
The jungle leaves cover me
I flick my tongue
I listen to the sounds in the tree
This tree has a familiar smell
I coil my body into two loops.
Coiled on a jungle branch.

lines.zh: 阳光只有几点落在我身上
lines.en: Only a few flecks of sun reach me
I wait for a small bird to come close
I am the same color as the vine.
There are higher branches above
My tail wraps the branch tip
Nobody will find me here
I wait for a leaf to fall
There is an old mark on the branch
You looked up and saw me
I hang my head from under a leaf.
I move faster than you run
You need no net
To catch me, you must keep up
I do not bite, I only flee
Your hand is too close to my head
I coil a little tighter
There are branches everywhere in this jungle
Change direction and you will lose me
Do not put your fingers forward

lines.zh: 这棵树对你我都不算小
lines.en: This tree is big enough for both of us
I contracted and lost a length
I slid a little off the branch
I am slick, hard to hold
That landed on my scales

lines.zh: 我的细鳞蹭掉了一小片。
lines.en: A few fine scales scrape off.
I make no sound, snakes do not
I tuck my head into my coils
I remember that knock clearly
I can still move
I climb higher
This smell has something to it

lines.zh: 你把果子往下递，我头才探出来。
lines.en: Lower the fruit, and only then do I bring my head out.
I do not much eat these
Set it lower
I am only interested in this tree

lines.zh: 丛林里虫子多，我自己找
lines.en: There are plenty of bugs here, I find my own
This will fall
I put my head out to look
One more move and I leave
Moving things interest me more
I am not very hungry
What you hold is still moving

lines.zh: 这东西掉下树我就不要了
lines.en: If it falls out of the tree I do not want it
I stretch my head out to sniff

lines.zh: 丛林里到处是我能吃的
lines.en: There is plenty for me in this jungle
Do not shake the tree
You touched my tail
I slipped away at once
My scales are slick
That made me coil tighter
Your hand closed on nothing

lines.zh: 我绕到了你背后那根枝
lines.en: I circled to the branch behind you
The branch swayed
I am cold, that will startle you
Do not grip my neck

lines.zh: 我已经在另一根枝上了
lines.en: I am on another branch already
There are others of us in these trees

lines.zh: 我闻到了另一条的味道
lines.en: I smell another one

lines.zh: 两条盘在一起的枝要够粗
lines.en: The branch for two must be thick enough
We do not wrap around each other
It moves as fast as I do
We take a branch each
It left first

lines.zh: 树林这么大，遇得上就遇上
lines.en: The wood is large, we meet when we meet
The paths in the trees are not hard
Perhaps tomorrow it is on this tree again
I strike at it and miss
I nudge it with my head
It is on the branch, I go around it
Too heavy, I cannot carry it
I push it along ahead of me
It will not fit in my mouth
If it falls, I do not chase
I pass it between the branches
I cannot swallow this
I let it drop
Something moved on a leaf
I hear the leaves rustle.
Something is moving in the tree
I can get there faster than it can move
My head points that way
I need not run at this distance

lines.zh: 我盘了一下，准备弹出去
lines.en: I coil, ready to spring
Its wings are trembling
I have chosen my route
Straight along this branch
I chase it along the branches
I know these trees better than it does
My body hugs the branch.

lines.zh: 我的身子在枝上折成几段
lines.en: My body folds in a few places along the branch
It took flight, so I wait
The wind makes the branches sway
I have never fallen
It has landed back on the tree
I move along the bark
A little closer and I can spring
I lunge and strike
My head is blunt, but my teeth are there
I whip off the branch at you.
My body lashed once
I pulled back quickly
I scraped off a bit of bark
That hardly hurt it

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的护腕上。
lines.en: I bite down on your bracer.
I drop back onto the branch
I prefer hiding to fighting
I coil on a low branch
One more serpent in the jungle
I climbed a stretch first
This tree has enough branches
I put my head out from under the leaves
It is warm here, and easy to hide
I circle the trunk once
I have learned these few routes

lines.zh: 我身上还带着树叶的味道
lines.en: I still smell of leaves
I coil my body tight

lines.zh: 火燎到我的鳞，我往后退
lines.en: Fire touched my scales and I pulled back

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下来，摔在落叶里
lines.en: I fell from the branch into the leaf litter
Water slows me right down
The blast threw me off the tree

lines.zh: 飞来的东西擦过我的身子
lines.en: Something flying grazed my body
That force nailed me to the branch

lines.zh: 树上没东西吃，我越来越瘦
lines.en: Nothing to eat up here, I grow thin

lines.zh: 雷光把整棵树都照白了。
lines.en: The lightning bleached the whole tree white.
There are no branches in the void
